questions.topic: PrepLadder · 20.Disorders of Carbohydrate and Amino Acid Metabolism
questions.stem: A 4-month-old infant presents with hepatomegaly, hypoglycemic seizures, and a doll-like face with fat cheeks. Laboratory tests reveal hypoglycemia, lactic acidosis, hyperuricemia, and hyperlipidemia. Which of the following is not a correct statement about this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: It is caused by a deficiency in glucose-6-phosphatase or its translocase

options.label: B
options.text: The condition is inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern

options.label: C
options.text: Glucagon administration typically leads to a significant increase in blood glucose levels

options.label: D
options.text: Treatment involves maintaining normal blood glucose levels through multiple feeds at regular intervals.
